name: Grull Hawkwind
summary: At Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa, Grull Hawkwind guides young tauren through their first trials. As Chief Hawkwind’s son, he prepares hunters and warriors to test their resolve and honor their ancestors.

sections.title: A Chieftain's Son
sections.body: At Camp Narache, Grull Hawkwind helps prepare the tribe’s youth. The son of Chief Hawkwind, he guides new arrivals on Red Cloud Mesa and judges whether they are ready to serve the Shu'halo. He sets trials of stamina, tracking, and survival against plainstriders and mountain cougars. Through these trials, young tauren learn that balance and respect for nature are foundations of life in Mulgore.

faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind guides young tauren at Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa. He is the son of Chief Hawkwind and mentors those beginning their journey.

faq.q: What role does Grull Hawkwind play for young adventurers?
faq.answer: Grull Hawkwind assesses novice tauren’s basic training and gives them early trials in hunting and survival across the surrounding plains.

faq.q: Is Grull related to the camp's leadership?
aliases: is grull related to the chief
faq.answer: Yes. Grull Hawkwind is the son of Chief Hawkwind, the chieftain of Camp Narache. He upholds his father’s traditions and helps prepare the camp’s defenders.

angles.text: As a young tauren on Red Cloud Mesa, you may meet Grull Hawkwind, one of the first braves to test you and introduce you to Shu'halo traditions.
As a hunter in Mulgore, you face Grull Hawkwind’s early trials, which test your patience and skill against the local wildlife.
